## Projects I'm Most Proud Of

### 🤖 [Warehouse Inspection Robot](https://github.com/Onafuwadav/ros2-warehouse-inspector)
> *Personal project*

A simulated ROS 2 robot that maps warehouse, patrols warehouse shelves, checking shelf marker labels and reports to live dashboard with a grounded AI assistant for querying inspection data

**Stack:** ROS 2 · Gazebo · Python · C++ · FastAPI · React

[📂 Source Code](https://github.com/Onafuwadav/ros2-warehouse-inspector)

### ♟️ [Chess Engine](https://github.com/Onafuwadav/Chess_bot)
> *Personal project*

C++ chess engine refined with search optimisation techniques rated around 1681 Elo based on 200 games against strength limited Stockfish with tests running in GitHub Actions on every push

**Stack:** C++ · CMake · Catch2 · Emscripten · GitHub Actions

[♟️ Play it in the browser](https://onafuwadav.github.io/Chess_bot/) | [📂 Source Code](https://github.com/Onafuwadav/Chess_bot)
